verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Aleph serves an llms.txt at getaleph.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-readable product summary (aleph-probe-1). Its entries describe spreadsheet sync, forecasting and headcount planning (aleph-docs-2, -3, -4). However, the content looks like marketing-level feature descriptions rather than in-depth agent-oriented documentation, and the markdown docs variant returns 404 (aleph-probe-2). Missing for 10: markdown (.md) versions of doc pages, deeper technical/agent-oriented docs content beyond a product summary, and independent corroboration of agents successfully using it.
